title: Billed versus estimated cost
eyebrow: Check the estimates against what providers actually charged
explain: Every cost Course Core shows is an estimate from your price list. Type in what a provider billed for a period, from its invoice or usage page, to see how far the estimate was off. Course Core never reads billing data from providers.
providerHint: A name you will recognise, such as the provider and account. Letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes.
amountHint: For example 12.50. Up to six decimal places.
amountInvalid: Type an amount in US dollars, for example 12.50.
sourceHint: For example “October invoice, line 3”. Never a card or account number.
saved: Recorded. It is listed below with the estimate for the same days.
table: Billed amounts and estimates (days in UTC)
calls: {count, plural, one {# call} two {# calls} other {# calls}}
